# Aggregate web mode does not open a local store, so ambient selectors do not
# participate in its selector validation.
env CARDAMOM_STORE=$WORK/missing-store
env CARDAMOM_BOARD=missing-board

! exec card web --no-browser --source primary=http://127.0.0.1:1
! stdout .
stderr 'embedded web assets: web assets not found'
! stderr 'cannot be combined with --store or --board'

# Explicit selectors remain incompatible with aggregate web mode.
! exec card --store $WORK/explicit-store web --no-browser --source primary=http://127.0.0.1:1
! stdout .
stderr 'web: --source cannot be combined with --store or --board'

! exec card --board explicit-board web --no-browser --source primary=http://127.0.0.1:1
! stdout .
stderr 'web: --source cannot be combined with --store or --board'
